note: Five regulars. Three sit at the table each night. Faces are drawn in code as a coloured circle with eyes and a mouth that changes with mood. All numbers are placeholders to tune.

regulars.name: Dot
regulars.personality: Decisive and competitive. Looks smug when she is close to winning.

shopping.style: Buys anything for her set the moment she can afford it.

regulars.name: Mabel
regulars.personality: Gentle and careful. Takes her time over everything.

shopping.style: Saves for big items and thinks hard before buying.

regulars.name: Rex
regulars.personality: Cheerful and scatterbrained. Sometimes shouts bingo when he has not got it.

shopping.style: Buys whatever takes his fancy. His ring is a different speed every time.

regulars.name: Pearl
regulars.personality: Stylish and a little proud. Hates losing a prize she had her eye on.

shopping.style: Steady and deliberate. Goes for the best-looking thing in her set.

regulars.name: Gus
regulars.personality: Gruff but kind. Grumbles when the caller goes too fast.

shopping.style: Slow to decide, but stubborn once he has chosen.

awayReasons: {name} is at a grandchild's birthday tonight.
{name} is on holiday at the Gold Coast.

ringIns.note: A ring-in fills an empty seat for one night. Pick a name, give them some credits, and point them at one prize on the table, preferring one that belongs to a set the player is working on. They keep no history.
introductions: {name} is filling in from the next suburb.
{name} is visiting from the club down the road.
{name} is here with a friend tonight.

The {prize} at home broke last week.
